steps.name: Step 0 (setup) — create the 'result' custom state variable via the STATE panel, so it's selectable in the Code node's Output combobox later
Step 1 — Add a Code node via canvas '+' button -> 'Code'
Step 2 — 'Click on Code node to open configuration panel': the node config side panel is open right after adding the node (CODE Type + Value visible in it)
Step 3 — Verify panel shows: CODE (Type+Value), Input, Output, Structured output (Interrupt before/after toggles removed from node cards, EL-3872)
Step 4 — In CODE section: set Type to 'Fixed', enter Value with Python code
Step 5 — Set Input combobox — add variable "input"
Step 6 — Set Output combobox — add variable "result"
Step 7 — Save the pipeline; verify no console errors and a 201 Created response
